title: A Weekend Trip to the Night Market
passage:
On Saturday evening, Jason's family decided to visit the night market near their town. "I will try the stinky tofu this time," Jason said excitedly, looking at the busy food stalls.

"You have to finish your homework before we leave," Mom reminded him. "We don't have much time, so hurry up."

Jason quickly packed his bag and finished his last math question. "Finally! I don't have to worry about homework anymore," he said with a big smile.

At the market, bright lights and delicious smells filled the air. Tina, Jason's sister, pointed at a stall selling fresh fruit. "I will buy some mango juice. It smells amazing!"

"We must be careful with our money," Dad said. "We don't have to buy everything we see."

They walked past toy stalls, clothing stores, and a game booth where kids threw rings onto bottles. Jason tried three times but didn't win anything. "Don't worry," the shop owner said kindly. "You can try again next week."

After eating noodles, grilled squid, and sweet potato balls, the family sat on a bench to rest. "I'm looking forward to coming back here," Tina said happily. "I also enjoy trying new street food every time."

"Next weekend, we will visit the market on the other side of town," Dad suggested. "It has an even bigger night market with more game booths."

Jason nodded with excitement. "I can't wait! I will save my allowance so I can buy a special gift for Grandma."

On their way home, everyone agreed that the night market trip was the best part of their weekend. They were already looking forward to their next adventure together.

grammar: will 表示未來的預測、決定或承諾：I will try the stinky tofu this time. / Next weekend, we will visit the market on the other side of town.
have to / don't have to 表示必須 / 不必：You have to finish your homework before we leave. / We don't have to buy everything we see.
look forward to + V-ing 表示期待某事，to 後面須接動詞的 -ing 形式：I'm looking forward to coming back here. / They were already looking forward to their next adventure together.

reading.q: Why did Jason finish his homework quickly?
opts: He wanted to go to the night market with his family
reading.ex: Jason 想和家人一起去逛夜市，所以趕快寫完功課。

reading.q: What did Tina want to buy at the fruit stall?
reading.ex: Tina 說她要買芒果汁（mango juice），因為聞起來很香。

reading.q: What happened when Jason played the ring-toss game?
opts: He tried three times but didn't win anything
reading.ex: Jason 玩套圈圈遊戲，試了三次都沒贏，但老闆鼓勵他下次再來。

reading.q: What did Dad suggest for next weekend?
opts: Visiting a bigger night market on the other side of town
reading.ex: 爸爸建議下週末去城鎮另一邊更大的夜市。

reading.q: What does Jason plan to do with his allowance?
opts: Save it for a gift for Grandma
reading.ex: Jason 說他要存零用錢，買禮物送給奶奶。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence using "will" for a decision made now.
opts: I try the stinky tofu this time.
I will try the stinky tofu this time.
I trying the stinky tofu this time.
I am try the stinky tofu this time.
grammar.ex: "will" 用於表達說話當下做出的決定，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence with "have to".
opts: You have finish your homework before we leave.
You has to finish your homework before we leave.
You have to finish your homework before we leave.
You having to finish your homework before we leave.
grammar.ex: "have to + 原形動詞" 表示必須做某事，主詞為 You 時用 have to，故選 C。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence with "don't have to".
opts: We don't have to buy everything we see.
We not have to buy everything we see.
We don't has to buy everything we see.
We haven't to buy everything we see.
grammar.ex: "don't have to + 原形動詞" 表示不必做某事，故選 A。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence using "look forward to + V-ing".
opts: I'm looking forward to come back here.
I'm looking forward to coming back here.
I look forward to came back here.
I'm look forward to coming back here.
grammar.ex: "look forward to" 後面須接動詞 -ing 形式，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the sentence that correctly uses "will" for a future plan.
opts: Next weekend, we visit the market.
Next weekend, we will visit the market.
Next weekend, we visiting the market.
Next weekend, we are visit the market.
grammar.ex: "will" 用於描述未來的計畫，故選 B。

What does "allowance" mean in "I will save my allowance"?
What does "stall" mean in "a stall selling fresh fruit"?
What does "adventure" mean in "their next adventure together"?
